items.t: Ignition switch can fail and cut headlights and wipers (recall)
items.job: Replace electrical part of ignition switch
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Throttle may not return to idle after a backfire (recall)
items.job: Install retaining ring on air flow meter screen
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Outer tie rod ends can wear early (recall)
items.job: Replace outer tie rod ends and align front wheels
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Reduced brake assist in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Install brake booster vacuum bypass system
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Oil sludge in the 1.8T engine
items.job: Drop oil pan, clean sludge, replace oil pump and pickup
items.note: If the engine was damaged by low oil pressure, a used or rebuilt engine costs much more.

items.t: Fuel filler neck can be damaged if a rear tire comes apart (recall)
items.job: Install new rear wheel house liner
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel lines and vent valves can crack under the car (recall)
items.job: Add heat shields and replace fuel line or vent valve
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel gauge can read full when the tank is low (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel level sending units
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Ignition coil failures
items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs
items.note: Some shops replace only the failed coil, which costs less.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake light switch may not work correctly (recall)
items.job: Install redesigned brake light switch
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Diesel can leak from the high-pressure pump (recall)
items.job: Replace diesel high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Tie rod nuts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Install new tie rod nuts at proper torque
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake booster vacuum line can crack in cold weather (recall)
items.job: Install redesigned brake booster vacuum line
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Wiper motor can quit in heavy rain (recall)
items.job: Install wiper motor cover and sealing kit
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. A failed wiper motor costs more to replace.

items.t: Cam follower wear on the 2.0T FSI
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump cam follower
items.note: If the camshaft lobe is worn, the camshaft and possibly the fuel pump add a lot to the cost.

items.t: Fuel pump control module can lose power and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump control module
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Sudden idle surge with the A/C on (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power steering can drop out at startup (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering gear
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: If the chain already skipped, engine damage can cost far more.

items.t: Clock spring damage can disable the driver airbag (recall, 2010 and 2012-2014)
items.job: Replace steering wheel clock spring
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Diesel fuel filter may leak (recall)
items.job: Replace diesel fuel filter elements
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Low-beam headlight bulb can lose contact (recall)
items.job: Replace low-beam bulb holder
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driveshaft boot near the exhaust can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace driveshaft heat shield (and boot if damaged)
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission hesitation, harsh shifts or limp mode
items.job: Transmission fluid service, software update and adaptation
items.note: If the mechatronic unit or clutches must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Headlight aim cap may be missing (recall)
items.job: Install headlight aim blocking cap
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission oil cooler seals may leak (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission oil cooler seals
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel rail cap can leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rails
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Left rear brake line may leak (recall)
items.job: Tighten left rear brake line fitting and bleed brakes
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front seatback may not lock in place (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct seat recliner bracket
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump drive can fail (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software
items.note: Recall software update is free at a VW dealer. A failed vacuum pump costs more.

items.t: Fuel rail may come loose and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace cylinder head to secure fuel rail
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake line connections may seep fluid (recall)
items.job: Replace affected brake lines and bleed brakes
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake caliper bracket bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Torque brake caliper bracket bolts
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake caliper pistons may reduce braking (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Bleed brakes and replace calipers if needed
items.note: Do-not-drive recall. Repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger front airbag may be folded wrong (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger front airbag
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Wrong side airbag may be installed (recall)
items.job: Replace side airbag
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front wheel bearing bolts may be under-tightened (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front wheel bearing bolts
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.
